questions.q_en: On 8th April 2024 it was Tuesday. What was the day of the week on 20th August 2025?
questions.solution_en:
Odd days in a month:

We get the number of odd days in a month when the number of days of a month is divided by 7.

MonthOdd no of Days
Months having 31 days (Jan, March, May, July, Aug, Oct, Dec)3
Months having 30 days (April, June, Sept, Nov)2
February (if ordinary year/If leap year)0/1

Here, in the given question, consider the time from 8th April 2024 to 31st December 2024.

No. of odd days till 31st December 2024 = 22 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 = 43 (1 odd days)

Hence, the number of odd days from 8th April 2024 to 31st December 2024= 1. -------- (1)

Additionally, the number of days between 1st January, 2025 to 20th August 2025.

No. of odd days till 20th August 2025= 3+0(2025 being a non-leap year)+3+2+3+2+3 + 20 = 36(5 weeks 1 days)

Hence, the number of odd days till 20th August 2025= 1. -------- (2)

Adding (1) and (2) we get,

Total odd days = 1 + 1 = 2 (2 day)

Hence, we get 2 odd days.

Tuesday + 2 = Thursday

Hence, it was Thursday on 20th August 2025.

questions.q_en:
Given below is a statement (Cause) followed by possible effects numbered I, II and III.

Read the 'Cause' carefully and decide which of the three can be possible effect/s.

Cause - Heavy rains yesterday in City X have caused flooding in many areas including the railway station and airport.

Effect I - Railways has announced a delay in the departure of three trains scheduled to start from City X this morning.

Effect II - A number of flights were unable to land in the airport of City X last evening.

Effect III - Finance ministry has extended the date for filing tax returns by a month.
options_en: Only I is a possible effect
Both I and II are possible effects
Both II and III are possible effects
Only II is a possible effect
questions.solution_en:
The correct effects of the cause - heavy rains causing flooding in City X - are I and II. Effect I is logical because train delays often result from waterlogging. Effect II also fits, as bad weather can disrupt flight landings. Effect III, however, is unrelated; tax filing extensions are financial decisions, not directly linked to weather. Hence, options I and II are valid effects of the stated cause.

So, Both I and II are possible effects.

Thus, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: In a queue, 85 people are standing. J is standing 10th from the front and K is standing 24th from the last. L is standing exactly between J and K. Where is L standing from the front?
questions.solution_en:
Number of people standing between J and K = 85 - (10 + 24) = 83 - 34 = 51.

Hence, L is at 26th position from both J and K.

L's position from front = J's position from front + L's position from J = 10 + 26 = 36.
